assertion_review.reason: Removing exactly the eight added lines reproduces the entire old scenario file after LF normalization. Existing cases, assertions, resets and fail-on-failure aggregation remain. In each of8 existing source/preference matrix cases, two new assertions check the actual null prototype and independent literal expected own keys/order/values. The equal helper at12 compares JSON.stringify strings, so key order is genuinely checked. Expected local/cloud/both/empty JSON is not derived from returned output or a second merge algorithm. parity_review.reason: The script separately loads saved original and current production source, then extracts real cloneWftJson and mergeWftSettings bodies. Original bytes bind to Gitbd5441a, and independently verified merge hashes differ. Each observation uses a fresh VM and fresh operands. assert.equal compares old/new serialized observations before marking a case passed: getter read trace, error.message, null prototype, own-key order and output values. Circular self references force the real clone fallback; inherited enumerable properties, hidden keys and symbols exercise exclusion. Throwing getters produce a real propagated message/trace. No expected merge result is substituted.
parity_review.matrix: 7 modes x2 boolean preferences: metadata, both rosters, one roster, false/null roster, circular clone fallback, null inputs, throwing getter.

The probe compares error.message, not error constructor/stack/identity. Self-reference outputs use local/cloud-reference labels. It is not exhaustive proxy or adversarial mutation coverage.
